texts: good. "every part of" routes into a per-part rule that carries the walker, the part walked, the each-morning schedule and the molting-season window together, and it fires as soon as any part of the base is named.

good. the daily recording parses both as one group event and as a per-collector rule, with the collection, the Watch ledger and the every-morning schedule all covered; the only open point is an internal head choice (whether a written medium counts as a location), which costs no content.
